description: This source file defines the GroovyEngine class, a specialized service engine in the Apache OFBiz framework that executes Groovy scripts as services. It handles script execution, context preparation, and error handling specific to Groovy-based service logic.

classes.name: GroovyEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine, responsible for executing Groovy scripts as services with context management and error handling.

methods.name: createProtectedKeys
methods.description: Creates an unmodifiable set of keys that are protected from modification within script contexts.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service asynchronously, ignoring the result, by calling runSync.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Synchronously executes a Groovy script-based service, preparing the scripting environment, handling exceptions, and returning the result.
